data.author: Map
data.comment: Implementation decision (AC4): `wl doctor --json` retains its existing top-level shape — a raw JSON array of findings — and appends pending-upgrade information as an additive synthetic finding with `checkId: upgrade.pending`, `type: pending-upgrade`, `itemId: null`, and `context: { pendingMigrations, pendingMigrationCount, outdatedHooks, outdatedHookCount }`. The alternative `{ findings, pendingUpgrades }` object was rejected because it would change the top-level shape from array to object and break existing consumers. Detection is read-only and best-effort (wrapped in try/catch), reuses listPendingMigrations(), detectHooksTargetDir() and dryRunHooks(), and exit code stays 0.
